scope.language: finite explicit English grammar; not generic NL understanding
scope.subject: literal record noun phrase, exact normalized string matching
scope.property: literal named count property, exact normalized string matching
scope.dimension_unit: positive integer count, individual unit implicit in count; no conversion or external unit knowledge
scope.constraints: two opposing explicit bounds or between/from range with explicit lower/upper closure; [L,U) or(L,U] plus equal endpoints handled exactly
scope.arithmetic: positive integer literals, single integer addition/subtraction expressed explicitly; no eval
scope.query_complete: full-match supported sentence forms; additional/uncovered clauses cause abstention
scope.document_complete: full supported grounded fact sentences; recognized ID/model/date metadata ignored, otherwise unsupported clauses cause UNKNOWN
scope.support_limits: new syntax not covered remains valid coverage failure, never patched from new eval outcomes

M1_rule: replace only parsed arithmetic expression spans with exact result; all other bytes preserved; same query canonical semantic tuple required, else technical failure; unsupported unchanged ABSTAIN_REWRITE
M2_rule: override iff query complete and exactly one candidateSATISFIES and otherVIOLATES from uniquely grounded same-subject/property/unit facts; otherwise base scores/order/tie retained
M2_score_semantics: bucket plus original score ranking_key, original base scores and margin retained; no synthetic neural logit or same-scale M2 margin
development_exposure: old16DEV and48reference text are exposed; no new eval before lock

bm25.corpus: All36 unique new EVAL documents,auxiliary included;fixed across conditions

bge_small.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

analysis.primary_ranking: both orientations correct after passage mapping; exact ties fail; technical missing kept separate
analysis.M0_M1_margin: gold score minus counterpart raw score; +/-1e-6 and1e-5 near ties, report mean/median per model only
analysis.M2_margin: not applicable; original M0 margin is recorded context
analysis.harm_denominator: number originally correct under M0, NA when zero
analysis.M1_preservation: text-only canonical comparison plus independent sealed semantic audit, no private-label-driven rewrite
analysis.probes: separate fallback/actions; no gold accuracy for semantic nonuniqueness
analysis.template_analysis: fourtemplate descriptive block means andleave-one-template-out only; no population significance
analysis.data_designation: template_related_exploratory unless independently defensible syntax holdout; oldreference excluded from new denominators
